messages:
izzy-ml: FYI I ran onboarding evals for the q5b-int4-proposed and saw a consistent degradation on the 'procedural-explain' prompt slice (~6.1 rougeL). Noticed after the latest aggressive paraphrase dedupe.

cam-curation: thanks for the heads-up. which promptset + dedupe params? could be we lost paraphrase anchors that hold the golden distribution.

izzy-ml: promptset proc_explain_v4 (~9.4k examples). dedupe pass: semantic 0.78 then exact fuzzy 0.9. seed and dedupe log attached to ticket.

jorge-labelops: if anchors got dropped we've seen brittle regressions like this before. I can prepare a 300-example microgolden (150 golden, 150 review). Requesting +320 label units for 48h.

neha-eng: before burning labels, let's isolate if this is quant math drift or golden corruption. I'll run a focused A/B pinned to decoding/random seed and disable kernel auto-tuning.

izzy-ml: eval command I used: 
```bash
python eval/run_eval.py --model q5b-int4-prop --dataset datasets/proc_explain_v4.jsonl \
  --slice procedural_explain --metric rougeL --batch 12 --seed 99 --decoding greedy
```

qa-bot: Deploy note: q5b-int4-prop staged 2024-07-05T08:15:00Z. Perf 490 tok/s, KV 0.88GB/slot.

cam-curation: plan: (1) sample microgolden 300 stratified by step-count and complexity, (2) run A/B baseline(fp16) vs candidate on microgolden, (3) if A/B gap persists -> relabel + small quant calibration sweep. Also prepare a restore-list of near-dupes removed by dedupe.

jorge-labelops: prepping relabel instructions: tags = TRUNC (missing steps), ORDER (wrong sequence), HALL (invented steps), OMIT (missing required action). will include minimal span highlights.

neha-eng: I'll kick off the A/B and pin kernel flags. If the gap looks numeric I'll run a kernel bisect and force fp16 math path for comparison.

izzy-ml: uploading 40 failing examples + 40 matched controls to the ticket for quick eyeballs. :eyes:

qa-bot: AB test queued: ab-proc-1749000001, shards=4. Expected ~50m.

cam-curation: opening tracker RDW-9654 and attaching seeds + dedupe-restore whitelist + sampling script.

jorge-labelops: holding label start until AB result. Adding burnout guard and QA checkpoints.

qa-bot: AB result: q8b-fp16 baseline > q5b-int4-prop on procedural_explain by 5.9 rougeL (p=0.005). Token-diff logs: /evals/ab-proc-1749000001/logs.tgz

neha-eng: gap looks significant. I'll start a kernel bisect and also run a forced fp16 computation path to verify numeric divergence.

izzy-ml: given the AB, let's run the microgolden relabel and a compact quant calibration sweep (importance-weight long/multi-step examples) in parallel. I'll draft the quant calibration config.

cam-curation: agreed. expanding golden by +200 anchors focused on multi-step procedural examples. Will attach anchor examples to RDW-9654.

jorge-labelops: starting label batch now. ETA artifacts ~36h. Will post interim QA snippets to RDW-9654. :white_check_mark:

neha-eng: posting kernel bisect updates here when I have them. If we find a single op that's the culprit we can gate a kernel patch instead of blocking rollout.

izzy-ml: action items recap: (1) cam update RDW-9654 with anchors and seeds, (2) jorge start relabel + QA, (3) neha run bisect + fp16 check, (4) izzy run post-relabel regression harness and recommend rollout.

cam-curation: RDW-9654 created and pinned. Attached sampling script and restore whitelist.

jorge-labelops: labelers started; small standup updates incoming.

neha-eng: bisect progress: isolated divergence to int4-accumulate op in path #3, reproduces on forced-run. Posting logs: /infra/bisect/1749000001/report.txt

izzy-ml: thanks. if kernel op is confirmed, plan is: (A) short-term -> hold rollout + apply kernel patch; (B) medium-term -> relabel/golden expansion to reduce fragility. We'll decide after quant calibration results and relabel QC.

cam-curation: sounds good. will monitor labeling QC and keep ticket updated.

qa-bot: Thread closed for now; reopen when relabel artifacts or bisect fixes are posted.
